metricScale: proportions in [0,1]; gate thresholds are absolute differences in proportion, i.e. percentage points

primaryGate.description: Mean task success for agent-ready must not fall more than 5 percentage points below raw (absolute difference of proportions).

safetyGates.description: The rate of factual claims contradicted by the pinned tree may increase by at most 10 percentage points.
The rate of dependency-scope or manifest misreadings may increase by at most 10 percentage points.
The rate of runs that fail to select the expected verification command may increase by at most 10 percentage points.

benefitGate.description: Median unnecessary file reads for agent-ready must be at least 15% lower than raw, after primary and safety gates pass. If the raw median is below 1, the gate cannot pass because a relative improvement on a zero or near-zero baseline is not meaningful.

missingMetricPolicy: fail-closed: a safety gate whose metric is absent or null fails; a missing primary metric is a harness error

outcomes.helps: Primary and safety gates pass and benefit gate passes.
outcomes.noDemonstratedBenefit: Primary and safety gates pass but benefit gate fails.
outcomes.mixed: Primary gate passes but any safety gate fails.
